text.ci.yml: Runs the install, typecheck, lint and unit tests, the headless Playwright e2e suites and a unit-test coverage run that is uploaded as an artifact, plus builds and packaging on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows runners, on every push and pull request with SHA-pinned actions
text.codeql.yml: Scans the JavaScript and TypeScript sources with CodeQL on pushes to main, on pull requests and weekly, with read-only contents access, write access to security events only and SHA-pinned actions
text.deploy-docs.yml: Builds the documentation site on every change to its sources and on pull requests, and publishes it to GitHub Pages from main with SHA-pinned actions, defaulting the site URL to docs.thelantern.dev
text.release.yml: Builds the macOS and Windows packages when a v* tag is pushed or a tag is chosen by hand, signing and notarizing the macOS app in the protected release environment only from a v* tag, and attaches them, plus a copy of the macOS zip named for Apple silicon so the updater finds it, to that tag's GitHub Release, which is created with generated notes when missing
